mathematics.assertion_tested: Lean kernel acceptance of the finite prescribed-parameter polynomial lifting criterion for actual integer polynomials, lower roots, split actual Jacobian blocks, and fixed free-coordinate digits; finite solved-block cokernel obstruction vanishes exactly when an actual next-level residue root exists with those fixed parameter digits; actual residue fibers are kernel torsors and have prime-modulus count p^(m-rank J), else zero; inherited lifting, chart, and root-motion theorems; expanded statement contracts and mathematically invalid controls
mathematics.coefficient_domain: New prescribed theorem: finite rectangular systems of integer polynomials in m solved and k parameter variables, e equations, positive modulus q, natural depth L>=1, lower root x and parameter digits v in (Z/q)^k. The obstruction criterion and actual fiber equivalence include composite q and q=1; vector-space rank-nullity counts require prime p
mathematics.conventions: F(x)=q^L r is derived from the actual lower-root divisibility hypothesis; J and K are the first m and last k columns of the actual Jacobian modulo q; obstruction is [rbar+K v] in coker J; actual y residues lie modulo q^(L+1), reduce to x modulo q^L, satisfy F(y)=0 modulo q^(L+1), and have parameter coordinates x_free+q^L v; count exponent uses m-rank J
